sentences.text: Sk.Mastanvali vs State Of Ap on 18 September, 2019

Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5528 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioners/accused seek to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.805 of 2018 on the file of the Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Kandukur, where cognizance was taken against them for the offences under Sections 272, 273, 275, 120(b), 420 of IPC and Sec.30(2)(a), 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act, 2006).

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Kandukur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 14.12.2017, when the complainant along with his staff proceeded to Ponnalur side, they found a person by the side of the road holding a white gunny bag near Mutharasupalem junction; on seeing the police he tried to hide behind trees to conceal himself; on enquiry, he revealed that he along with others has been purchasing and selling the tobacco products illegally; the Police seized the contraband under the cover of mediator's report.
Subsequently, A2 to A21 were arrested.

After the investigation, police filed charge sheet for the offences stated supra.
3. Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners under Sections 272, 273, 275, 120(b), 420 of IPC and Sec.30(2)(a), 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, Interlocutory Applications pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.
_ U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J Date: 18.09.2019 pab Sk.Mastanvali vs State Of Ap on 18 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129297847/
